description: This file contains functions related to working with git bundle files, including displaying bundle data and checking object counts within a bundle.

methods.name: convert_bundle_to_pack
methods.description: Reads a git bundle, bypassing the header, and outputs the pack data.

methods.name: test_bundle_object_count
methods.description: Checks whether the number of objects in a git bundle matches the expected count, optionally handling thin packs.
